title: Brown Butter Banana Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, browned, plus 1 tablespoon butter for greasing the pan
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin with 1 tablespoon butter.
Brown 1/2 cup butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, about 5 minutes. Let it cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk the mashed bananas, 2 eggs, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup milk, 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla and the browned butter.
In a second bowl whisk 2 cups flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet until just combined, then fold in the walnuts.
Divide the batter among the cups, about 1/3 cup each, and bake 18 to 20 minutes.
